$comment: 04D Spring Boot migration ladder. Data, not code: scripts/lib/references.js reads it to plan a multi-edge path from any Boot line to any later one, and to pick the OpenRewrite recipe each edge runs. Every Boot line is one rung; a pack in references/ supplies the rules for each major boundary. Recipe names were verified against the jars on Maven Central (META-INF/rewrite/*.yml); licences were read from each artifact's own POM <licenses> element on 2026-10-01. Latest patches and Spring Cloud trains are re-read from Maven Central metadata at detect time; the values here are only the offline fallback.

license_policies.open-source-only: Only recipe stacks whose every artifact is under an OSI-approved licence. The default.
license_policies.source-available: Also allows the Moderne Source Available License recipe stack (free to use internally on your own code; not OSI open source; may not be offered to third parties as a service). Must be chosen explicitly and is recorded in the evidence.

apache-2.0.evidence: rewrite-spring 5.24.1 (2024-11-28) is the last Apache-2.0 release; 5.25.0 (2024-12-18) onwards is Moderne Source Available. Its POM pins rewrite 8.41.1, rewrite-migrate-java 2.30.1, rewrite-testing-frameworks 2.23.1, rewrite-hibernate 1.13.1, rewrite-java-dependencies 1.24.1, rewrite-static-analysis 1.21.1, rewrite-apache 1.9.1, rewrite-micrometer 0.11.1, rewrite-openapi 0.10.1, rewrite-reactive-streams 0.6.1 — every one Apache-2.0 per its POM. rewrite-maven-plugin 5.46.1 (2024-11-28, rewrite 8.41.1) and the Gradle plugin 6.28.1 (2024-11-28) are Apache-2.0. Verified at run time (validation run V1, 2.7.12 -> 3.5.16): all 34 org.openrewrite jars the plugin loaded declare Apache-2.0 in their POM, including the transitive rewrite-logging-frameworks 2.17.0, rewrite-jenkins 0.18.1, rewrite-github-actions 2.10.1, rewrite-csharp 0.16.1, rewrite-analysis 2.13.1, rewrite-kotlin 1.23.1 and rewrite-templating 1.19.1. (Their newer lines — e.g. rewrite-logging-frameworks 3.x, rewrite-jenkins 0.37, rewrite-github-actions 3.x — are Moderne Source Available; the 5.24.1 pins keep them out.)

core-apache-2.0.evidence: rewrite-maven-plugin 6.46.1 and everything it depends on (rewrite-core/java/java-8..25/maven/xml/groovy/kotlin/polyglot) are Apache-2.0. Only OpenRewrite's built-in recipes (xml ChangeTagValue for the parent pin, ChangeType, ChangePackage, ChangePropertyValue, ChangeDependencyGroupIdAndArtifactId, AddDependency, UpgradeDependencyVersion, ...) are used — no recipe artifact.

moderne-source-available.evidence: rewrite-spring 6.x and its recipe dependencies (rewrite-migrate-java 3.x, rewrite-testing-frameworks 3.x, rewrite-hibernate 2.x, ...) declare the Moderne Source Available License: royalty-free for internal use and derivative works, but not OSI open source and not to be offered to third parties as a service.

lines.note: rewrite-spring 6.37.1 has no UpgradeSpringBoot_4_1; only the 4.1 property migrations. The 4.0 boundary edge carries the code migration.

oss_composites.$comment: 04D-authored declarative recipes built only from Apache-2.0 OpenRewrite core recipes, keyed by the major a MAJOR_BOUNDARY rung enters. Used under open-source-only when no Apache-2.0 upstream recipe covers the rung. A same-major rung with no Apache-2.0 recipe runs the edge pin alone (parent/BOM, Java, Spring Cloud train) and relies on compiler-driven repair for the rest.

cloud.$comment: Spring Cloud release train compatible with each Boot line (Spring Cloud's published compatibility table). At detect time 04D re-reads the latest GA patch of each train from Maven Central and confirms the train's Boot version from its spring-cloud-starter-parent POM (up to 2025.0) or, from 2025.1 on (no starter parent is published), from the <spring-boot.version> of the spring-cloud-build release its BOM names. 2025.1 (Boot 4.0/4.1) is GA since 2025.1.0; 2025.1.3 was the latest patch on 2026-10-01. null = no GA train for that line.
